title: A redaction toolkit
description:
Write the redaction functions every log line in an API client should pass through (lesson 2.05).

```python
def redact_headers(headers): ...
def redact_url(url): ...
def redact_json(value): ...
```

**redact_headers** returns a new dict with the same names, in the same order. Names are compared ignoring case:

- `Authorization` and `Proxy-Authorization`: if the value has a space, keep the scheme before it and replace the rest with `REDACTED` (`Bearer REDACTED`); otherwise the whole value becomes `REDACTED`.
- `Cookie`, `Set-Cookie`, and any name starting with `x-` and ending with `-key` or `-token` (such as `X-Api-Key`): the value becomes `REDACTED`.
- Everything else is unchanged.

**redact_url** replaces the values of the query parameters `api_key`, `key`, `token`, `access_token`, `refresh_token`, `client_secret`, `signature` and `password` (any case) with `REDACTED`, and a password in the URL itself (`https://user:pass@host/`) with `REDACTED`. If a query parameter was replaced, the query is rebuilt with `urlencode` from the pairs in their original order (blank values kept); otherwise the query is kept exactly as given, and a URL with nothing to redact is returned unchanged.

**redact_json** returns a copy of a parsed JSON value in which, at any depth, the value of every object key named `password`, `secret`, `client_secret`, `token`, `access_token`, `refresh_token` or `api_key` (any case) is replaced by `REDACTED`. The input is not changed.
hints: `value.partition(" ")` splits at the first space and tells you whether there was one, which is all `Authorization` needs.
For URLs, `urlsplit` gives you the network location and the query separately. Rebuild the query only when a parameter was actually redacted, so other URLs come back byte for byte.

The parts `urlsplit` gives, and how to put them back together:

```python-norun
from urllib.parse import urlsplit, urlunsplit

parts = urlsplit("https://ada:pw@api.example.com/v1?a=1")
parts.netloc      # "ada:pw@api.example.com"
parts.query       # "a=1"
urlunsplit(parts._replace(netloc="ada:REDACTED@api.example.com"))
# "https://ada:REDACTED@api.example.com/v1?a=1"
```
